findings.observation: The DoS alert records 1137 flows, 16165 packets, two destination ports and one source in its one-minute aggregation window.
Sampled connections from 192.168.10.25 to 173.223.152.83 on destination port 443 include packet counts of 15, 40 and 4; these records alone cannot establish service disruption.
